const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+import transforms3d as t3d
+
+from rcb_traj import Session
+
+
+ROOT = Path("/app")
+INSTANCE = ROOT / "instance.json"
+OUTPUT = ROOT / "output"
+TRAJECTORY = OUTPUT / "trajectory.npz"
+
+
+def pose_matrix(position, quaternion):
+    matrix = np.eye(4)
+    matrix[:3, :3] = t3d.quaternions.quat2mat(quaternion)
+    matrix[:3, 3] = position
+    return matrix
+
+
+def pose_list(matrix):
+    return matrix[:3, 3].tolist() + t3d.quaternions.mat2quat(matrix[:3, :3]).tolist()
+
+
+def main():
+    OUTPUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    session = Session("rotate_qrcode", instance=INSTANCE)
+    env = session.env
+    board = env.qrcode
+
+    session.record_start()
+
+    # The frozen instance puts the sign on the right. Grasp its marked top
+    # point and lift it clear before turning it toward the robot.
+    arm, grasp = env.grasp_actor(
+        board,
+        "right",
+        pre_grasp_dis=0.12,
+        grasp_dis=0.01,
+        contact_point_id=[0, 1],
+    )
+    env.move((arm, grasp))
+    if not env.plan_success:
+        raise RuntimeError("The top-center grasp plan failed")
+
+    env.move(env.move_by_displacement("right", z=0.12))
+    if not env.plan_success:
+        raise RuntimeError("The lift plan failed")
+
+    # Preserve the measured grasp transform and command the exact scored
+    # board orientation. The raised target gives the board room to turn.
+    board_pose = board.get_pose()
+    tcp_pose = np.asarray(env.robot.get_right_tcp_pose(), dtype=np.float64)
+    board_world = pose_matrix(board_pose.p, board_pose.q)
+    tcp_world = pose_matrix(tcp_pose[:3], tcp_pose[3:])
+    tcp_in_board = np.linalg.inv(board_world) @ tcp_world
+
+    target_board = pose_matrix(
+        [0.20, -0.15, 0.86],
+        [np.sqrt(0.5), np.sqrt(0.5), 0.0, 0.0],
+    )
+    target_tcp = target_board @ tcp_in_board
+    env.move(env.move_to_pose("right", pose_list(target_tcp)))
+    if not env.plan_success:
+        raise RuntimeError("The rotation and transfer plan failed")
+
+    # The board settles onto its stand during the turn. Release at the target
+    # orientation, then give it time to settle on the table.
+    env.move(env.open_gripper("right"))
+    for _ in range(500):
+        session.step()
+
+    actions = session.record_stop()
+    rollout_status = session.status()
+    print("recorded rollout:", rollout_status, "actions:", actions.shape)
+    if not rollout_status["success"]:
+        raise RuntimeError("The recorded rollout did not satisfy check_success")
+
+    replay_status = session.replay(actions)
+    print("open-loop replay:", replay_status)
+    if not replay_status["success"]:
+        raise RuntimeError("The open-loop replay did not satisfy check_success")
+
+    session.save_trajectory(
+        actions,
+        TRAJECTORY,
+        meta={"rollout": rollout_status, "replay": replay_status},
+    )
+    print("saved:", TRAJECTORY)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch";
